seed_rule: 2026113400 + 100 * stratum_index + panel_index; both indices are zero-based

candidate_interval.name: Gaussian fit-coordinate parameter propagation with max-T family upper
candidate_interval.studentization: per-cell sample SD across transformed parameter draws
candidate_interval.critical_value: higher empirical quantile at 1-alpha of each draw's maximum one-sided studentized q/h/x deviation, clamped below at zero
candidate_interval.invalid_draw_rule: any invalid q/h/x parameter transform fails the entire panel interval; retain all planned draws

comparison.baseline: same-panel finite-difference delta normal upper with Bonferroni-72 family adjustment
comparison.estimand: panel-level simultaneous containment of all 72 exact synthetic q/h/x truths

screening_rule: If any stratum has fewer than 10/12 valid panel-level familywise successes, or any max-T panel interval abstains, stop this candidate. If every stratum reaches at least 10/12 with no interval abstentions, it is only eligible for separately reviewed confirmatory calibration; no synthetic screen certifies coverage.
